name: Mailchimp
description: Email marketing platform: Marketing API for audiences, campaigns, automations, reports and e-commerce, plus a separate Transactional (Mandrill) API.
access_notes: Any Mailchimp account holder can generate API keys self-serve (Profile > Extras > API keys); a free plan exists so credentials cost nothing. API keys are used via HTTP Basic auth (any username, key as password). For multi-tenant integrations Mailchimp directs developers to OAuth 2 - app registration is self-serve in-account, no partner approval needed to obtain client_id/secret. What the API can do depends on the account's plan level.
mcp_notes: Official vendor MCP exists but only for Mailchimp Transactional (Mandrill) at https://mandrillapp.com/mcp (Bearer Transactional API key); there is no official MCP for the Marketing API. Composio MAILCHIMP toolkit exists (275 tools, 4 triggers, OAuth2, Composio-managed auth available).
uncertainty_notes: Community MCP servers for the Marketing API exist (e.g. damientilman/mailchimp-mcp-server) but were not evaluated for reputability. The Mailchimp app in Claude/ChatGPT (Intuit partnership) is an end-user connector, not a developer-facing MCP endpoint.

evidence.note: 'You can authenticate requests using either your API key or an OAuth access token'; API used via Basic auth; 'To use the Marketing API, you need a Mailchimp account. What you can do with the API depends on what level of Mailchimp plan you have'
OAuth 2 guide for accessing other users' Mailchimp data; app registration self-serve, endpoints login.mailchimp.com/oauth2/authorize and /token
Official guide for audience webhooks (subscribe/unsubscribe/campaign events) configurable via UI or /lists/{list_id}/webhooks endpoint
Official Mailchimp doc for the Transactional Messaging MCP server at https://mandrillapp.com/mcp, authenticated with a Transactional API key
Composio toolkit catalog lists MAILCHIMP: 275 tools, 4 triggers, OAUTH2, Composio-managed app available
